Here are the three substantive documents recovered from the separate Astra environment:

Balanced Fock Attenuators: the full working proof, including the three-photon minimum-output-entropy result. It has not had external review, and novelty remains unconfirmed.
Conserved-Charge Integration for Doped Fermions: an exact reduction and negative-weight counterexample. It does not solve the general fermion sign problem.
Rotating-Bridge Pairing: the construction, correction and physical limitations. It does not establish superconductivity.

All three are PDFs and contain no Python files.
